sentences.text: Sot Sam ha darkë te Drita.
sentences.english: Today Sam has dinner at Drita's.

sentences.text: Gjyshja Drita bën bukë dhe oriz.
sentences.english: Grandmother Drita makes bread and rice.
The plates are on the table.
Everyone sits down at the table.

sentences.text: Pastaj Ardi dhe Sam lajnë pjatat.
sentences.english: Then Ardi and Sam wash the plates.
